note.zh-TW: 教材原字「短期放貨」疑為「短期放款」的誤植，修正寫法等老師確認（T09）後才改主要顯示；日文原型是短期貸付金。
note.en: The course wording is probably a typo for short-term loans; the main display stays as written until the teacher confirms (T09). The term comes from the Japanese short-term loans receivable.

definition.zh-TW: 公司把錢借給別人、預計一年內收回的債權。它是流動資產，也是速動比率的一項；本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: Money the business has lent to others and expects to collect within a year. It is a current asset and one of the quick assets; the course story does not use it.
